audit.whatIsWrong: Full and content layers disagreed on four of seven rows (full: Skill/Skill/Diana/Skill/Skill for rows 3-6; content and packet: Diana/Azir/Diana/Azir).
audit.why: Content and the packet chart agree with each other, and the mechanics support them: levels 4-5 are hers because Crescent Strike is down to 7s and every mark refunds Lunar Rush, level 6 is yours because Emperor's Divide is terrain her dash cannot cross, first item is hers again while your 120s ult is down more often than not.
audit.corrected: Full layer moved to Diana / Azir / Diana / Azir for rows 3-6, with each why rewritten to argue that verdict.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[2].text spiked her first item on 'Riftmaker/Night Harvester timers'; whys[3] put Moonfall at levels 4-5.
audit.why: Moonfall does not exist before level 6, so it cannot explain the 4-5 row. Naming two alternative mythics as a 'timer' says nothing actionable.
audit.corrected: Levels 4-5 explained by Crescent Strike hitting 7s with the Lunar Rush refund; the first-item spike stated as Riftmaker sustain beating soldier chip.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[0].text called the dash 'Crescent Strike-into-Pale Cascade dash' — Pale Cascade is the shield, Lunar Rush is the dash. breakdown.cooldowns contained no digit. The Lunar Rush refund rule was described vaguely as 'Moonlight marks reset her dash' and never given a number.
audit.why: Riot's text: Lunar Rush has no cooldown when used onto an enemy afflicted with Moonlight, and dashing removes Moonlight from everyone else. So the arc (900 range, 8/7.5/7/6.5/6) is the real dash timer, and a dodged arc leaves Lunar Rush at 22/20/18/16/14. Azir's Emperor's Divide creates terrain, which is what stops the dash from crossing.
audit.corrected: Lunar Rush named and its refund condition stated with both cooldowns; Pale Cascade correctly identified as the shield, including that its third sphere detonating on minions thickens it.
sources: brief enemyKit Q/W/E/R text and cooldowns

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[2].d offered a 'fifteen-second invitation' after a wasted Crescent Strike.
audit.why: Crescent Strike is 8/7.5/7/6.5/6 — the window is six to eight seconds, not fifteen.
audit.corrected: Real window written in, and tied to what it actually buys you: no free Lunar Rush.

edits.before: - Diana Crescent Strike: matchup-defining — Moonlight marks reset her dash — sidestep the arc and her dive has no follow-up. Check it before every step-up. - E Shifting Sands is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Crescent Strike: 8s at rank 1, 6s maxed, and Lunar Rush costs no cooldown onto the mark it leaves — so the arc is the real dash timer. Dodge it and her E sits at 22s. - Moonfall is 100s at rank 1 and Shifting Sands 22s: spend neither on chip damage.

edits.before: Ahead, siege: crash waves with soldier autos, take every plate, and rotate to river with R held — your wall converts even fights into massacres.
edits.after: Ahead, take her angles away: crash with soldier autos, take plates, and hold Emperor's Divide — she has to cross terrain you can raise in front of her.

edits.before: Carry through siege control — soldiers take plates, R denies engages, and your DPS curve outlasts every assassin spike in the lobby.
edits.after: Carry by keeping the distance: Lunar Rush reaches 825 and needs a body to land on, so soldiers plus the wall leave her without a landing spot.

edits.before: If Diana gets a kill, the lane gets honest — give Crescent Strike extra room and farm it back. Two kills: stop dueling your tilt — farm at soldier range and stay relevant through wave control.
edits.after: If Diana gets a kill, stop standing on the arc — every Crescent Strike that lands is a free Lunar Rush at you. Farm the back of the wave, keep Shifting Sands for the dive, and let her shove into your tower.

edits.before: Best wave: a controlled slow push you crash with soldier autos — the crash funds your roam, your plates, and your scuttle-fight presence. Worst wave: a frozen wave near his tower with your E down — walking up to reset it is the most-ganked walk in mid lane. Crash timing: shove with a destination in mind; mid waves are bus tickets, not chores.
edits.after: Best wave: crashed into her tower, so she farms with Lunar Rush pointed away from you and her Q spent on minions. Worst wave: frozen on her side with Shifting Sands down — that is where the mark lands and the dash is free. Crash timing: crash before she hits 6, then ward the side she wants to walk to, because her roam is on foot.

edits.before: Diana's Crescent Strike gives her a mark-and-dash combo that can blow through a soldier or two to land on you, and because her Pale Cascade AoE detonates hardest in melee range, she punishes any wave you push too far forward.

edits.before: Her all-in only gets scarier at 6 with Moonfall's pull, letting her force fights the instant Crescent Strike is up — this is her most dangerous window and you need Divide or ally peel to survive it, though there are stretches where her cooldowns are down and trades even out.
edits.after: At 6 Moonfall pulls from 475 and turns any landed Crescent Strike into a full commit, and that is her best window. Emperor's Divide is the answer: the wall is terrain her dash cannot cross, so hold it for her jump instead of for the wave and make her walk in on foot.

edits.before: With Emperor's Divide unlocked and a full soldier wall up, you finally have the tools to zone her jump-in entirely, forcing her to walk into your Divide knockup before she can ever close the gap — full-build Azir out-ranges and out-scales a diving assassin-bruiser.
edits.after: With Emperor's Divide up and soldiers banked you own her entry: the wall is terrain, so Lunar Rush cannot cross it and she has to walk into the knockback instead. Full-build Azir out-ranges an 825 dash and out-scales a bruiser who has to be in melee.

notes: Diana is female and the male template was everywhere (tldr, winCon, tradeGood, tradeBad, breakdown.trading, loading, three dosFull titles, dontsFull[2].t, report 0/1/3/9/11) — all corrected. The packet's four suspectNames are FALSE POSITIVES: Crescent Strike, Pale Cascade and Emperor's Divide are all the real names; the near-miss was the surrounding words, not the ability. The real naming error was in spikes[0].text, which called the dash 'Pale Cascade' — the dash is Lunar Rush. Chart: full disagreed with content and the packet on rows 3-6; aligned to Diana / Azir / Diana / Azir with every why rewritten in the same proposal. Left phases[N].rating alone (see questions). Emperor's Divide blocking Lunar Rush is stated on the strength of the kit's terrain flag plus Riot's own wall description; the finer questions — whether she can dash to a target on the far side, whether the knockback interrupts Moonfall's delay — are not in Riot's text and are not asserted anywhere.
